decision: Every material mutation must belong to a wave with explicit ownership, acceptance criteria, evidence and handoff.
AGENTS.md is the execution authority; tool-specific instruction files are shims and may not fork policy.
GOAL.md remains stable while STATE.md and machine JSON are mutable frontier mirrors; ledgers/evidence preserve chronology.
context: Separate mission contracts from operational state.

decision: Acquire pinned upstreams as partial Git object stores with immutable local pin refs, then materialize only source/config through an explicit sparse projection.
context: OpenClaw/Omi are too large for indiscriminate worktree acquisition; CP01 needs complete provenance without downloading irrelevant binary/model/media assets.

decision: Graphify preserves raw source evidence and COSGraph adds non-destructive integration facets; neither raw symbol counts nor provisional COS groups constitute the CP01 capability denominator.
context: Prevent heuristic extraction from becoming destructive deduplication or false parity. W03/W04 own behavioral-surface promotion and canonicalization.

decision: Graph engineering uses four one-way planes: P0 SOURCE_EVIDENCE -> P1 SEMANTIC_SURFACE -> P2 COS20D_DECISION -> P3 AGENT_CONTEXT; higher planes never mutate lower evidence.
context: Separate primary provenance from semantic candidates, provisional architecture decisions and agent recovery context.

decision: COS-20L runtime responsibility and COS-20D change/integration analysis are orthogonal; 20D is projected onto components, decisions, waves and ContextPacks rather than every raw source node.
context: Preserve analytical depth without multiplying a million-node forensic graph into an unusable artifact.

decision: Integration promotion follows OBSERVED_SOURCE -> DISCOVERED_CANDIDATE -> BEHAVIOR_MAPPED -> CONTRACT_MAPPED -> TEST_MAPPED -> VERIFIED -> MIGRATION_ELIGIBLE; destructive convergence is forbidden before MIGRATION_ELIGIBLE.
context: Prevent CANONICALIZE/MERGE_STATE/REWRITE_LATER hypotheses from becoming premature migrations.

decision: The future-agent ContextPack is a deterministic derived recovery view generated from canonical state and ledgers; it is never an independent source of truth and drift must fail CI.
context: Eliminate dependence on chat history while preventing derived context from inventing project state.

decision: Evidence gates are bound to the exact candidate HEAD; cancelled, timed-out, superseded or partial workflow runs never close a wave and their cause must be recorded before rerun.
context: W02 demonstrated that acquisition success plus a cancelled structural compiler is not structural-inventory evidence.
CP01 release candidate passed all W03-W08 invariants and produced a non-empty behavior-mapped denominator.
decision: Close CP01 and enter CP02 from the exact-source full-compiler release candidate while preserving VERIFIED parity at zero and forbidding migration.

context: W02-07 establishes the security contract that W02-08 provider/model adapters must consume. Local inference does not require an external egress grant.
decision: External inference remains deny-by-default. Authorization must bind principal, session, provider, exact canonical HTTPS origin, expiry and explicit token/cost ceilings; provider credentials cross only the trusted secret-store boundary as opaque handles and never enter audit/debug payloads.

context: This preserves pinned OpenJarvis lifecycle semantics without creating a Python self-authorization path or using model/catalog discovery as parity proof.
decision: W02-08 is a lifecycle/catalog bridge, not an inference execution lane. REGISTERED never implies SERVING; SERVING requires successful prepare plus native list_models, health and can_serve checks. External native lifecycle calls remain fail-closed until an admitted Rust T0 W02-07 path exists.

context: PR #41 exposed a false-negative release gate after W02-08 was already evidence-backed COMPLETE. The behavioral, security and parity lanes were green; only stale frontier assertions failed.
decision: Release and PR gates validate the durable post-finalization DAG frontier; staging-only READY/BLOCKED assertions may not be reused after an exact-head finalizer advances task state.

context: This is the smallest portable real-weight lane that satisfies G2 artifact readiness while preserving the W02-10 boundary between model materialization and actual unary inference.
decision: Use OpenJarvis catalog model qwen3:0.6b with the llamacpp engine for the first L2 real-model lane, pinning the base-model revision, llama.cpp runtime commit and a Q4_K_M GGUF artifact by immutable revision, exact byte size and SHA-256. Acquisition is an explicit network phase; integrity verification is repeated offline. W02-09 never executes inference.

context: Minimum real M1 proof without prematurely implementing streaming, cancellation, fallback, tools or parity promotion.
decision: G3 unary inference is a single-flight loopback-only OpenJarvis llamacpp lane bound to the exact W02-09 model artifact; Rust retains admission, identity, correlation and terminal validation and output is validated structurally rather than by exact prose.

context: Bound the G4 streaming lane without smuggling W02-12 cancellation or W02-13 structured/tool semantics into W02-11.
decision: W02-11 streaming is strictly ordered from sequence 1, emits a terminal only after successful native iterator completion, and poisons protocol state on duplicate, reordered, EOF-before-terminal or invalid terminal behavior; typed/tool fragments remain deferred and fail closed.

context: The v1.2 contract has InferenceCancel but no distinct Ack message. Reusing the typed cancel body as a correlated ACK preserves the existing additive wire contract while keeping remote/provider cessation explicitly UNKNOWN.
decision: W02-12 uses explicit single-flight request/attempt ownership and treats InferenceCancel echo as transport ACK only; success requires a later correlated CANCELLED terminal. Already-terminal, ACK-without-termination, EOF and timeout never become cancellation success.

context: W02-13 must preserve OpenJarvis rich streaming semantics without allowing model output to become a tool-execution permission channel. Canonical transport is intentionally left NOT_RUN until a typed additive contract is implemented.
decision: Model-emitted tool calls remain bounded inert data. Fragmented function arguments are assembled and JSON-validated, malicious names are preserved rather than executed or normalized into authority, and structured JSON is validated against a caller-supplied Draft 2020-12 schema without repair.
